title: Dillon 参与 VM 与 NFS 子系统
claim_text: Dillon 曾为 FreeBSD 与 Linux 内核的 VM、NFS 等子系统贡献代码
quote: Matt has also contributed code to The FreeBSD Project and the Linux kernel for subsystems such as VM and NFS.
notes: 原文只记“contributed code … such as VM and NFS”，未记“维护者”身份，题面用“参与”；第二源缺

title: 子系统清理早于自主重构
claim_text: 创立初期的内核改造以简化与清理既有子系统为主
quote: One of the important works included the simplification and general cleanup of the majority of the kernel subsystems.
notes: 第二源论文原句：the multiprocessing work requires a cleanup in the existing code base of old assumptions and dependencies that no longer hold in an MP environment.

title: 单系统映像曾是创立期的终极目标
claim_text: 原生集群支持（单系统映像）是 DragonFly 创立时的最终目标
quote: The ultimate goal of the DragonFly project at its inception was to provide native clustering support in the kernel.
notes: 第二源原句：The message passing system is also integral to future plans for clustering and single system image (SSI) support.

title: 集群目标虽退场却未退出设计
claim_text: 集群目标退场后仍影响此后多年的设计决策
quote: This original design direction, although no longer the primary goal of the DragonFly project, has influenced many of the design decisions made in the intervening years.
notes: 第二源缺；论文为分叉前文本，不能证“退场”

title: 全局大锁限制了 4.x 内核的多核并发
claim_text: FreeBSD 4.x 内核仍受单一全局锁约束，细粒度锁被列为 5.0 的新特性
quote: almost all interrupt handlers will immediately block on Giant and require a thread fix-up when they block.
notes: 第二源原句：Fine-grained locking in the kernel paves the road for much higher efficiency of multi-processor systems.（5.0 公告 2003-01-19）

title: namecache 重写被列为首要前置
claim_text: namecache 整体重写被视为集群化目标的前置工作
quote: The namecache has been completely rewritten and is now considered to be production-ready with this release. The rewrite will greatly simplify future filesystem work and is a necessary precursor for our ultimate goal of creating a clusterable OS.
notes: 第二源缺；团队页只列 namecache 为 Dillon 项目之一，不证“前置”

title: 发行说明把网络进展列在首位
claim_text: DragonFly 1.2.0 发行说明称网络子系统进展最大
quote: The greatest progress has been made in the network subsystem.
notes: 第二源为论文第 VI 节网络子系统专章（The work to distribute network processing across multiple processors was carried out in several stages），非同句；落块时按“网络子系统为早期重点”表述

title: 项目自述由 4.x 延续改为另立路线
claim_text: 项目最初自述为 FreeBSD 4.x 系列的逻辑延续，其后放弃该定位
quote: The project was originally billed as "the logical continuation of the FreeBSD 4.x series", as quoted in the announcement, but this description has long since become obsolete.
notes: 第二源原句：Its goals are to maintain the high quality and performance of the FreeBSD 4 branch, while exploring new concepts to further improve performance and stability.

claim_text: FreeBSD 5.0 与 5.1 的发布公告日期分别为 2003-01-19 与 2003-06-09
notes: 第二源原文首行：Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2003 09:36:57 -0700 (PDT)；题面用“发行”，落块应写“发布公告日期”，勿把公告日与 ISO 日混用

quote: The goal of SMPng is to allow concurrency in the kernel.
notes: 第二源原句：in place of the symmetric multiprocessing support being added to the upcoming FreeBSD 5 branch, DragonFlyBSD uses the concepts of partitioning and replication layered on top of a message passing system

notes: 第二源原句：forked from FreeBSD 4.8 in June of 2003

title: 改造覆盖文件系统接口与内核核心

quote: This involved a great deal of work in nearly every subsystem, particularly the filesystem APIs and kernel core.

title: 编译器默认值经 CCVER 过渡

quote: Both GCC 3.4.x and GCC 2.95.x are supported in this release through the use of the CCVER environment variable ('gcc2' or 'gcc34').
notes: 第二源原句：GCC 3.4 is now the default compiler. 2.95.x is no longer supported (it can't handle the new threading storage classes properly).

title: 发行分支只回合并兼容性修复

notes: 第二源原句：DragonFly's policy is to only commit bug fixes to release branches.
